annotation.title_clean: Continuous Belarusian hybrid attacks against Lithuania
annotation.title_en: Continuous Belarusian hybrid attacks against Lithuania
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament resolution condemning Belarus's hybrid attacks on Lithuania, including drone and balloon incursions, migration instrumentalisation and disinformation. It backs Lithuania's right to neutralise unmanned objects, calls for counter-UAV capabilities, the European Drone Defence Initiative, Eastern Flank Watch, EU-NATO cooperation and further sanctions on Belarus.
key_provisions_or_claims: Condemns Belarusian hybrid attacks including UAV and balloon incursions as deliberate and coordinated
Supports Lithuania's right to intercept or neutralise unmanned flying objects
Welcomes European Drone Defence Initiative and Eastern Flank Watch for counter-drone capability
Calls for deeper EU-NATO and EU-Ukraine cooperation on counter-UAV and drone technologies
Calls for additional targeted and sectoral sanctions on Belarus
